question: how do i cross the flooded rooms in black mesa without getting shocked
reply:
Alright, listen up, you young grasshopper. That flooded water ain't no kiddie pool; it’s got a constant zap. Don't try to time it, mate, you'll get fried faster than a cheap transistor.
If you wanna cross, you gotta think high. Use whatever you can find that ain't touching the water—desks, cabinets, those floating crates, even overhead pipes, they work like a charm. If there's a gap that's too wide to just jump, don't panic. Grab some those loose wooden crates and shove 'em into the water to make your own little stepping stones.
But here's the real trick, see? If you can find that red wall switch, or a breaker, or whatever the heck it is, cut the power. Turn that thing off, and the water goes safe for good. Simple as that.
why: Every claim in the reply is the corrected note: the current is constant, do not try to time it, cross on desks/cabinets/crates/overhead pipes, push loose wooden crates in as stepping stones, and cut the power at a red wall switch or breaker. The old note's dangerous advice - wait for a gap in the cycle, move while the water is dark - does not appear.
